title: TUB-* items
summary: Inner tube item family covering wheel sizes from 20-inch to 29-inch, including current stock across Manchester and Leeds warehouses.

infobox.items: TUB-20, TUB-24, TUB-26, TUB-27.5, TUB-28, TUB-29

body:
The `TUB-*` item family comprises bicycle inner tubes across standard wheel diameters used in Northbridge Cycles assembly and spares. As of 26 October 2026 at 09:00 GMT, inventory is distributed across the central store at Manchester (`WH-MAN-STR`) and the Leeds store (`WH-LDS-STR`). Stock levels range from critical shortages on sizes such as `TUB-26` to substantial availability on `TUB-24` and `TUB-29`.

| Code | Description | Item Family |
|---|---|---|
| `TUB-*` | Inner tubes | Component |

## Stock on hand

Inventory balances across warehouses are recorded in [[data-stock-on-hand|Stock_on_hand_2026-10-26_0900.xlsx]] as of 26 October 2026, 09:00 GMT:

| Item | Location | On hand | Allocated | On order |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `TUB-20` | `WH-MAN-STR` | 144 | 56 | 200 |
| `TUB-24` | `WH-MAN-STR` | 362 | 101 | 0 |
| `TUB-24` | `WH-LDS-STR` | 758 | 0 | 0 |
| `TUB-26` | `WH-MAN-STR` | 2 | 2 | 0 |
| `TUB-27.5` | `WH-MAN-STR` | 25 | 2 | 0 |
| `TUB-28` | `WH-MAN-STR` | 58 | 26 | 100 |
| `TUB-28` | `WH-LDS-STR` | 37 | 0 | — |
| `TUB-29` | `WH-MAN-STR` | 304 | 0 | 0 |

As of 26 October 2026 09:00, inner tube `TUB-20` at `WH-MAN-STR` has 144 units on hand, 56 allocated, and 200 on order.[^r1] Inner tube `TUB-24` has 362 units on hand (101 allocated, 0 on order) at `WH-MAN-STR` and 758 units on hand (0 allocated, 0 on order) at `WH-LDS-STR`.[^r2] Inner tube `TUB-26` at `WH-MAN-STR` has 2 units on hand, 2 allocated, and 0 on order.[^r3] At 09:00 on 26 October 2026, `WH-MAN-STR` holds 25 on hand, 2 allocated, and 0 on order of `TUB-27.5`.[^r4] At 09:00 on 26 October 2026, `TUB-28` stock stands at 58 on hand (26 allocated, 100 on order) at `WH-MAN-STR` and 37 on hand (0 allocated) at `WH-LDS-STR`.[^r5] At 09:00 on 26 October 2026, `WH-MAN-STR` holds 304 on hand, 0 allocated, and 0 on order of `TUB-29`.[^r6]
